evidence.detail: rs/l/J is a pure static rs/l/F sprite holder initialized only from the exact resources misc/singlesplus, misc/singlesplushot, popups/hp 0..3, hitmarks/old/poise and popups/scope.

Client consumes popups/hp 0..3 as the paired normal/high-health bar sprites while rendering actor health presentation.
The entity hitmark renderer rs/a/f consumes hitmarks/old/poise, while Client consumes popups/scope for the live scoped target/player presentation path.
